title: Private Idol Disc: Data-hen: Race Queen G
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ データ編 レースクイーンＧ
overview:
A database software featuring the full lineup of race queens, searchable by every field, from team to hometown!!

Race Queen G

Rapidly rising race queens appear! The second volume is GT and JTCC!!

This data edition of the Private Idol Disc series is a digital photo book and database of the race queens who model at GT and JTCC motor sports events. Look through their photos and short movies, read each woman's profile, and search the lineup by team, birthday, height, blood type, measurements, hometown and more.

- Photo Hall: photo albums
- Video Hall: short movies
- Information Hall: cast profiles and photos with a search function
- Bonus: a collection of answering machine messages
